Edinburg.notes: Small I-81 town between Mount Jackson and Woodstock.

Mount Jackson.notes: Town on I-81 and the North Fork in central Shenandoah County.

New Market.notes: Southern Shenandoah County town at I-81, known for the Civil War battlefield.

Strasburg.notes: Largest town in Shenandoah County, at the north end of the county near I-81 and US-55.

Toms Brook.notes: Small incorporated town between Woodstock and Strasburg.

Woodstock.notes: Shenandoah County seat with a walkable downtown on the Valley Pike.

Basye.notes: Western Shenandoah CDP that contains Bryce Resort. Use Basye as the community; Bryce Resort is the prominent neighborhood.

Maurertown.notes: CDP between Woodstock and Toms Brook.

Mount Clifton.notes: Very small Shenandoah CDP. No neighborhood pages.
